sloka: गतम् तु गन्गा पर पारम् आशु ।रामम् सुमन्त्रः प्रततम् निरीक्ष्य ।अध्व प्रकर्षात् विनिवृत्त दृष्टिर् ।र्मुमोच बाष्पम् व्यथितः तपस्वी ॥२-५२-१००॥
transliteration: gatam tu gangā para pāram āśu ।rāmam sumantraḥ pratatam nirīkṣya ।adhva prakarṣāt vinivṛtta dṛṣṭir ।rmumoca bāṣpam vyathitaḥ tapasvī ॥2-52-100॥

translations.english: The wretched Sumantra kept gazing at Rama who swiftly reached the other side of the Ganga and only when he could not see him because of long distance, he turned away his gaze and, overcome with grief, shed tears.
